messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple services reporting elevated 5xx rates (edge -> backend) in us-west-2 starting ~3951234500. Auto-paging sre-oncall and devs. See /alerts/5xx-spike-395123 for metrics.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Acknowledged paging. Starting initial triage.

pranav: seeing a big spike on the LB in front of classifier-service and convo-api, spikes correlate with a config push 10m ago to envoy route retry settings.

kai-eng: confirm - I rolled out a route change in dev stage and promoted to prod ~3951234400. It adjusted retries and per-route max connections.

sre-oncall: can you paste the config diff? we need to see retry & circuit breaker settings.

kai-eng: copy of the relevant fragment:
```
- route:
-   retry_policy:
-     retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream"
-     num_retries: 3
-   max_connections: 1000
+ route:
+   retry_policy:
+     retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream"
+     num_retries: 6
+   max_connections: 200
```

ashley-prod: customer-impact: internal telemetry shows a subset of customers getting repeated 502s and higher latency. Support queue up 12 tickets referencing timeouts since ~10:35 PDT. ETA for incident severity assignment?

emily-support: tagging affected accounts: alpha-inc, beta-saas, and gamma-platform. Sending proactive note to beta-saas now. Can we estimate RPS impacted?

li-devops: metrics: edge LB saw 4x request rate to convo-api which amplified retries -> backend hitting connection pool exhaustion. Circuit-breaker on backend started tripping, returning 503s. See these logs:
```
[envoy] upstream reset by peer, reason: connection failure
[upstream] circuit_breaker: max_connections exceeded
```

sre-oncall: hypothesis: increasing num_retries from 3 to 6 increased traffic amplification under transient backend errors, exhausting the pool and causing cascading 5xx. Plan: revert retry num to 3, temporarily raise max_connections on backend nodes, and reduce route weight to convo-api to throttle. Execs:

sre-oncall: @kai-eng can you rollback the route retry change? if you can't, we'll patch at the LB level.

kai-eng: rolling back now. pushing new envoy config with num_retries: 3. Deployment command:
```
envoyctl push-config --service convo-api --file envoy_routes_prod.yaml
```

sre-oncall: while that lands, I'm going to increase pool size and bump CB thresholds as emergency mitigation.

li-devops: running:
```
kubectl patch deploy convo-api -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"cb-bump":"3951234567"}}}}}'
```
in flight, scaling convo-api from 10 -> 18 replicas to absorb retry storms.

pranav: also disabling cross-zone retries temporarily (we saw cross-az amplification). Config snippet to flip:
```
retry_on: "connect-failure,refused-stream"
# removed 5xx for retries
```

sre-oncall: noted. I'm watching error-rate graphs. 5xx rate peaked ~20m ago, currently trending down after rollback started but still above baseline.

emily-support: support update sent to impacted customers: short note, "We're investigating increased errors and routing changes; mitigation in progress, will follow up." Will escalate to CSM for alpha-inc.

ashley-prod: Caroline from alpha-inc on a call asking for ETA and root cause. Please include rollback and mitigation steps in update.

kai-eng: rollback applied, envoy config diff shows num_retries=3. New config hash: sha256:fa12... Applying warm restart.

sre-oncall: I'm switching traffic routing: temporarily reduce route weight to convo-api by 40% to give backend more headroom. Command (control plane):
```
PATCH /v1/routes/convo-api
body: {"weight": 60}
```

li-devops: weight change applied. Confirmed 42% drop in RPS to convo-api at the edge.

pranav: seeing circuit_breaker counts drop, connection pool saturation reducing. 5xxs dropping from 18% -> 6% over the last 4 minutes.

sre-oncall: good. Next: full postmortem steps and timeline. For now: keep rollback, leave reduced weight until backend scales stabilize, and open a short-term playbook to avoid excessive retries in future rollouts.

emily-support: update to customers: "We've applied a rollback and temporary traffic reduction; errors are decreasing. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause analysis." Sending now.

ashley-prod: internal exec notes: RTO estimate 20-30m; impact limited to select accounts but high-visibility. Please loop in product and infra for a long-term fix.

kai-eng: will revert the retry change in the infra repo and add a canary step to limit retry increase to 5% traffic before global rollout.

li-devops: adding an alert threshold for retry-induced amplification (new metric: retry_amplification_ratio) so we can page before CB trips.

sre-oncall: anyone see residual errors? I'm tracking error budget and will start an incident report doc. If errors stay >2% for next 10m we'll escalate to SEV2.

pranav: errors at 3.1% now and trending down. Looks like mitigation is working.

emily-support: support queue: 3 new tickets opened but one is duplicate. Prioritizing alpha-inc follow-up.

sre-oncall: oncall handoff for next shift: @ashley-prod will take watch in 25m. I'll add notes and steps in the incident doc pointer: /incidents/3951234567-lb-route-threshold.

ashley-prod: taking handoff. thanks for the run. Please include exact revert command and traffic weight change in notes.

sre-oncall: posting commands for handoff:
```
# rollback retry
envoyctl push-config --service convo-api --file envoy_routes_prod.yaml
# scale back up after stabilization
kubectl scale deploy convo-api -n prod --replicas=12
# restore route weight
PATCH /v1/routes/convo-api body:{"weight":100}
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged, status: mitigation in progress, severity: SEV3 -> monitoring. Next update in 15m or on status change.

emily-support: prepping customer follow-up templates for postmortem.

pranav: quick note for postmortem: root cause = aggressive retry increase (num_retries from 3->6) combined with reduced max_connections, leading to connection pool exhaustion and CB trips. Contributing factor: rollout lacked traffic-limited canary.

li-devops: will add a guardrail to deployment pipeline to block retry escalations > +1 without canary flag.

ashley-prod: handing off to oncoming team. documented actions and customer comms. Closing loop for now, will reopen if regression.

sre-oncall: signed off from active pager. monitoring only. :thumbsup:
